d:
Bina bread ke Bread Pakoda! Sooji ki soft bread + aloo filling + hari chutney, kam oil mein
Ghar mein bread nahi hai? Koi baat nahi! Aaj Masala Kitchen mein Poonam Devnani aapko sikhayengi sooji se steam wali bread banakar canteen style Bread Pakoda banana.
Sooji aur dahi se soft bread banane ka tarika (1 cup sooji = 8 bread pieces)
Aloo filling + hari chutney + ketchup wala canteen style Bread Pakoda
Raat ko taiyari karke subah bina mehnat ke nashta (fridge tip)
Bachi hui bread: air fry ya tawa par 2 din baad ka doosra nashta
